description: This file contains integration tests for the 'Delete' functionality of articles in the Conduit project. It includes tests for deleting articles, articles with tags, and articles with comments, verifying the proper deletion behavior and side effects.

classes.name: DeleteTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple integration test methods for verifying the deletion of articles under various conditions.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article
methods.description: Tests the deletion of a simple article and verifies it no longer exists in the database.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Tags
methods.description: Tests the deletion of an article that has associated tags, ensuring the article and its tags are deleted.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Comments
methods.description: Tests the deletion of an article that has associated comments, ensuring both the article and its comments are properly removed.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article
methods.description: Asserts that an article can be deleted successfully and is no longer present in the database.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Tags
methods.description: Asserts successful deletion of an article with associated tags.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Comments
methods.description: Asserts successful deletion of an article with associated comments.
